LESSON: COOKING FOOD FRYING FRYING

Grade: Grade 5
Subject: AGRICULTURE
Strand: Food Production Processes
Topic 2.5: Cooking Food Frying Frying

SECTION 1: WELCOME

• Today’s class: Cooking Food Frying Frying
• How we learn: Teach → Worked example → Try this
• Use point notes. Show working. Then take the quiz.

• Fact 2 with a Kenyan example.
• Safe action connected to Cooking Food Frying Frying.

Try this
• Draw/label one diagram for Cooking Food Frying Frying.
• Write 5 bullet facts about Cooking Food Frying Frying.
• Say one safety rule.
